page_title: OSA 2-1 PAL | Osasuna v Las Palmas 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' The referee shows a yellow card to Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.
89' Here is a change. Abel Bretones is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
89' Substitution. Jon Moncayola will be replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
85' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz de Mera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
84' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
82' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
79' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
78' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
76' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
76' Substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) replaces Ante Budimir.
74' Luis Carrion prepares a substitution. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
74' It will be a substitution. Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is ready to enter the pitch as Dario Essugo walks off.
72' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
72' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Sergio Herrera, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
71' Las Palmas keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
69' The attendance for today's match is 19043.
68' The shots on goal statistics – 2:3.
64' Vicente Moreno has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moi Gomez (Osasuna) replacing Ruben Garcia.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Bryan Zaragoza will be replaced by Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
60' 2 - 1 Goal! Ruben Garcia tees up Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:1.
60' The resulting corner from Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is cleared.
59' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Las Palmas earn a corner.
57' Viti (Las Palmas) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
54' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
54' The ball falls kindly for Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post.
54' Osasuna are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
48' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
46' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) heads on.
46' Luis Carrion makes a switch. Oliver McBurnie is coming on in place of Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+9' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
45+6' Marvin (Las Palmas) is being substituted because of an injury. Luis Carrion sends Viti on the pitch.
45+5' Marvin (Las Palmas) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45+4' Marvin (Las Palmas) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
45+3' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for an infringement.
45+1' Luis Carrion has decided to substitute Mika Marmol and he is replaced by Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas).
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
44' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
41' 1 - 1 Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
41' The corner from Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is intercepted by the defence.
39' 1 - 0 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Jasper Cillessen.
39' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is going to take the penalty!
37' Looks like Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

35' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul. Osasuna are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
33' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
33' Osasuna take a short corner kick.
32' An attempted cross from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is cleared. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
32' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post!
29' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) has a goal ruled out for offside!
28' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
25' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Marvin (Las Palmas) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
22' The percentage of ball possession is – 57:43.
19' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
18' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
17' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Osasuna win a corner.
17' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
15' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
15' Osasuna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
12' The ball is cleared after Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' The referee blows his whistle as Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) was too aggressive in his challenge.
8' The Osasuna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Las Palmas are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' A bullet header by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post.
1' The first half has started.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera will supervise the game today.
